plugins.compose:
# 文件搜索：让 Agent 在授权的共享文件夹里按文件名、按内容找文件，读文件（ADR-0016）。只做这一件事：申请共享
# 文件夹的读权限，它们只读挂进容器，看不到别的；经 MCP 把工具交给核心的 MCP 总线，核心只路由和授权。
#
# 工具来自 rust-mcp-filesystem：默认只读，写文件、移动、打包这些工具都关掉；读的工具都标了 readOnlyHint，Agent
# 调用时不用主人确认。它只说 stdio，supergateway 转成 Streamable HTTP。镜像由 images/mcp/Dockerfile 构建。
name: files

services:
  mcp:
    # 开发环境在本机按 images/mcp/Dockerfile 构建（见 README），进正式的官方索引前改成发布的、按摘要固定的镜像。
    image: wonton-files:dev
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "${PUID}:${PGID}"
    command:
      - --stdio
      - >-
        rust-mcp-filesystem
        --disable-tools create_directory,move_file,write_file,edit_file,zip_files,unzip_file,zip_directory
        /shares/documents /shares/photos /shares/music /shares/videos /shares/downloads
      - --outputTransport
      - streamableHttp
      - --stateful
      - --port
      - "8080"
      - --healthEndpoint
      - /healthz
      - --healthCheck
      - server
    volumes:
      - ${WONTON_SHARE_DOCUMENTS}:/shares/documents:ro
      - ${WONTON_SHARE_PHOTOS}:/shares/photos:ro
      - ${WONTON_SHARE_MUSIC}:/shares/music:ro
      - ${WONTON_SHARE_VIDEOS}:/shares/videos:ro
      - ${WONTON_SHARE_DOWNLOADS}:/shares/downloads:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - node
        - -e
        - "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz').then(r => process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1), () => process.exit(1))"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 15s
      start_period: 30s
      start_interval: 2s

x-wonton:
  id: app.wonton.files
  version: 0.1.0
  kind: app
  title: { zh: 文件搜索, en: File search }
  description:
    zh: 让 Bot 在你授权的共享文件夹里按名字和内容找文件、读文件
    en: Lets bots find and read files in the shared folders you authorize
  category: files
  mcp:
    service: mcp
    port: 8080
    transport: streamable-http
  permissions:
    - storage.share.documents:read
    - storage.share.photos:read
    - storage.share.music:read
    - storage.share.videos:read
    - storage.share.downloads:read
  requirements:
    arch: [amd64, arm64]
    memory: 128M
